rows.grounds: locative plural of compound manīṣita-artha, 'desired purpose'
imperative of vini-yuj, 'to employ or direct'

items.question: For what purposes should the all-deluding yantra be employed?
items.inference: The all-deluding yantra should be employed for desired purposes.
uncertainties: exact scope of desired purposes unspecified
items.plain_english: Let one employ the all-deluding yantra for desired purposes.
